<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  <g font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif">
    <!-- status bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
    <line x1="331" y1="20" x2="331" y2="16" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="20" x2="336" y2="13" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="20" x2="341" y2="10" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="16" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="22" x2="357" y2="22" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="11" width="16" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="13" width="11" height="7" rx="1" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <line x1="386" y1="14" x2="386" y2="19" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- header -->
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="57" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,61 24,68 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="68" x2="39" y2="68" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="55" y="70" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Detalle del vuelo</text>
    <circle cx="359" cy="61" r="14" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="359" cy="67" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- page intro -->
    <text x="20" y="119" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tu vuelo</text>
    <text x="20" y="141" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Información de tu viaje realizado</text>

    <!-- main flight detail card shadow -->
    <rect x="15" y="157" width="361" height="329" rx="11" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="15" y="154" width="361" height="329" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- card heading -->
    <text x="31" y="181" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">LA2326</text>
    <rect x="278" y="166" width="81" height="24" rx="100" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="290" cy="178" r="5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <text x="300" y="182" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Completado</text>
    <line x1="31" y1="198" x2="359" y2="198" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- departure -->
    <text x="31" y="222" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">SALIDA</text>
    <text x="31" y="250" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">06:25</text>
    <text x="31" y="271" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Santiago</text>
    <text x="31" y="290" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">SCL · Terminal 2</text>
    <text x="31" y="311" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#110053">viernes, 14 de junio de 2024</text>

    <!-- arrival -->
    <text x="238" y="222" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">LLEGADA</text>
    <text x="238" y="250" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">08:40</text>
    <text x="238" y="271" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Lima</text>
    <text x="238" y="290" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">LIM · Terminal 1</text>
    <text x="238" y="311" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#110053">viernes, 14 de junio de 2024</text>

    <!-- route timeline -->
    <line x1="46" y1="331" x2="46" y2="388" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="331" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="388" r="6" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="388" x2="46" y2="412" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="46,412 40,404 52,404" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="66" y="337" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Embarque iniciado</text>
    <text x="66" y="355" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Puerta 18 · 05:45</text>
    <text x="66" y="394" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Aterrizaje confirmado</text>
    <text x="66" y="412" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Duración del vuelo · 2 h 15 min</text>

    <line x1="31" y1="430" x2="359" y2="430" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="31" y="454" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Economy</text>
    <text x="135" y="454" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Avión Airbus A320</text>
    <text x="312" y="454" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">2h 15m</text>

    <!-- actions -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="503" width="170" height="45" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="105" y="531" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Ver pase de abordar</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="200" y="503" width="170" height="45" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
      <text x="285" y="531" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Descargar recibo</text>
    </g>

    <!-- details section -->
    <text x="20" y="588" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Información del viaje</text>
    <rect x="15" y="602" width="361" height="95" rx="11" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="15" y="599" width="361" height="95" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="627" r="15" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <rect x="37" y="620" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="617" x2="40" y2="623" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="617" x2="46" y2="623" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="68" y="627" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Código de reserva</text>
    <text x="68" y="649" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Q7H4KP</text>
    <rect x="274" y="616" width="81" height="29" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <text x="314" y="635" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Copiar</text>
    <line x1="31" y1="667" x2="359" y2="667" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="31" y="686" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Pasajero: Valentina Rojas · Asiento 12A</text>

    <!-- baggage/info card -->
    <rect x="15" y="712" width="361" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FFF9E6" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="739" r="10" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <text x="39" y="744" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="59" y="735" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Equipaje incluido</text>
    <text x="59" y="753" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">1 bolso de mano · 1 artículo personal</text>

    <!-- bottom nav -->
    <rect x="0" y="781" width="390" height="63" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="781" x2="390" y2="781" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,801 48,793 57,801 57,812 51,812 51,805 45,805 45,812 39,812" fill="#110053"/>
      <text x="48" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Inicio</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="119" y="796" width="18" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="123" y1="793" x2="123" y2="799" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="133" y1="793" x2="133" y2="799" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="128" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Mis viajes</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="210" cy="802" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="217" y1="809" x2="223" y2="815" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="210" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Buscar</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="291" cy="798" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="291" cy="809" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="291" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Perfil</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <line x1="354" y1="795" x2="370" y2="795" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="354" y1="802" x2="370" y2="802" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="354" y1="809" x2="370" y2="809" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="362" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Menú</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
